Description

Distinct session, physical-window and physical-pane IDs.

Parsing and rendering are pure. An ID carries no endpoint, server lifetime or liveness evidence. Render an ID for external text; use its numeric accessor when an application needs the mathematical value.

Start with parseSessionId, parseWindowId or parsePaneId. Each type's documentation links its parser and renderer. Contextual numeric indices belong to LibTmux.Value.

>>> :set -XOverloadedStrings
>>> fmap renderWindowId (parseWindowId "@17")
Right "@17"
>>> either (const "rejected") renderPaneId (parsePaneId "@17")
"rejected"

data SessionId Source #

A session's unsigned 32-bit tmux identifier, written with a $ prefix. Parse with parseSessionId; render with renderSessionId.

data IdError Source #
